setup_instructions.step_1: Go to https://supabase.com and create a project
setup_instructions.step_2: Note your project URL and anon key (already in .env.local)
setup_instructions.step_3: In Supabase SQL Editor, run the migration file: supabase/migrations/001_init_pulsecity_schema.sql
setup_instructions.step_4: Create a storage bucket named 'issue-photos' and set it to public
